n_flights: int, total number of flights F; flight indices are 0,…,F-1 throughout.
n_airports: int, total number of airports A; airport indices are 0,…,A-1 throughout.
n_periods: int, total number H of equal-length actual time periods within a single day; all time values use integer period numbers 1,…,H. Position 0 of the period axis in arrays corresponds to period 1.
n_scenarios: int, total number of weather scenarios S; scenario indices are 0,…,S-1 throughout.
flight_departure_airport: list[int], length F; the f-th entry is the departure airport index of flight f, in the range 0,…,A-1.
flight_arrival_airport: list[int], length F; the f-th entry is the arrival airport index of flight f, in the range 0,…,A-1.
requested_departure_period: list[int], length F; the f-th entry is the requested departure period of flight f, in units of periods, taking values 1,…,H.
requested_arrival_period: list[int], length F; the f-th entry is the requested arrival period of flight f, in units of periods, taking values 1,…,H.
scheduled_enroute_duration: list[int], length F; the f-th entry is the fixed scheduled en-route duration of flight f, in units of periods; must equal requested_arrival_period[f] - requested_departure_period[f].
min_enroute_duration: list[int], length F; the f-th entry is the minimum allowed actual en-route duration of flight f in any scenario, in units of periods.
max_enroute_duration: list[int], length F; the f-th entry is the maximum allowed actual en-route duration of flight f in any scenario, in units of periods, and must not be less than the corresponding min_enroute_duration.
max_departure_delay: list[int], length F; the f-th entry is the maximum allowed departure delay of flight f, in units of periods, must be nonnegative.
max_arrival_delay: list[int], length F; the f-th entry is the maximum allowed arrival delay of flight f, in units of periods, must be nonnegative.
departure_delay_cost: list[float], length F; the f-th entry is the nonnegative cost incurred per period of departure delay of flight f.
arrival_delay_cost: list[float], length F; the f-th entry is the nonnegative cost incurred per period of arrival delay of flight f.
max_schedule_displacement: int, maximum scheduled departure displacement Δ shared by all flights, in units of periods; the absolute difference between the scheduled departure and the requested departure must not exceed this nonnegative integer.
schedule_connection_pairs: list[list[int]], list of ordered flight pairs for connections of the first type; each row must have exactly two elements [f,g], meaning flight g departs as a connection after flight f arrives. This set includes both the given aircraft turnaround connections and passenger itinerary connections.
schedule_min_connection_time: list[int], length must equal the number of rows of schedule_connection_pairs; the i-th entry is the minimum connection time required at the scheduling stage for the corresponding ordered flight pair, in units of periods.
aircraft_connection_pairs: list[list[int]], list of ordered flight pairs for connections of the second type; each row must have exactly two elements [f,g], denoting an aircraft turnaround connection between flight f and flight g that must be maintained during actual operations.
aircraft_min_connection_time: list[int], length must equal the number of rows of aircraft_connection_pairs; the i-th entry is the minimum actual connection time of the corresponding aircraft turnaround flight pair in each scenario, in units of periods.
scenario_probabilities: list[float], length S; the ω-th entry is the nonnegative probability of weather scenario ω, and all elements must sum to 1.
weather_condition: list[list[list[int]]], shape [S][A][H]; weather_condition[ω][a][t-1] denotes the operating condition of airport a in period t under scenario ω. Code 0 denotes VMC, 1 denotes IMC.
capacity_departure_coefficients: list[list[list[float]]], axes [condition][airport][segment], where condition=0 is VMC and condition=1 is IMC; entry [q][a][l] is the departure count coefficient of airport a on capacity envelope segment l under condition q. The length of the segment axis may vary by condition and airport.
capacity_arrival_coefficients: list[list[list[float]]], axes [condition][airport][segment]; entry [q][a][l] is the arrival count coefficient of the corresponding capacity envelope segment. For each [q][a], its segment length must be consistent with capacity_departure_coefficients and capacity_limits.
capacity_limits: list[list[list[float]]], axes [condition][airport][segment]; entry [q][a][l] is the capacity limit of the corresponding segment. Each segment requires that departure coefficient×departures in that period + arrival coefficient×arrivals in that period does not exceed this value; the input envelope for condition=1 should be tighter than for condition=0.
rho: float, schedule displacement cost weight ρ, in the range 0≤ρ≤1; the weight of the expected operational delay cost is 1-ρ.
